segments.title: Introduction to Cloud Computing and its Benefits

sub_topics.name: Introduction to Cloud Computing
sub_topics.description: Imagine you're the owner of a small software development firm and you want to scale your business up. However, a small team size, the unpredictability of demand, and limited resources are roadblocks for this expansion. That's when you hear about cloud computing.

sub_topics.name: Differences between On-Premise and Cloud-Based Computing
sub_topics.description: But before investing money into it, you decide to draw up the differences between on-premise and cloud-based computing to make a better decision. When it comes to scalability, you pay more for an on-premise setup and get lesser options, too. Cloud computing, on the other hand, allows you to pay only for how much you use, with much easier and faster provisions for scaling up or down.

key_points: Cloud computing offers scalability and cost-effectiveness
On-premise computing has limited scalability and higher costs
Cloud computing provides easier and faster provisions for scaling up or down

segments.title: Definition and Types of Cloud Computing

sub_topics.name: Definition of Cloud Computing
sub_topics.description: So now, thinking that cloud computing is a better option, you decide to take a closer look at what exactly cloud computing is. Cloud computing refers to the delivery of on-demand computing services over the Internet on a pay-as-you-go basis.

sub_topics.name: Types of Cloud Computing Models
sub_topics.description: Cloud computing has two types of models, deployment model and service model. There are three types of deployment models: public, private, and hybrid cloud.

key_points: Cloud computing is the delivery of on-demand computing services over the Internet
There are two types of cloud computing models: deployment and service models
There are three types of deployment models: public, private, and hybrid cloud

segments.title: Popular Cloud Computing Services and Their Differences

sub_topics.name: IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
sub_topics.description: And finally, we have SAS. Software and hardware requirements are satisfied by the vendors, so you don't have to manage any of those aspects of the solution.

sub_topics.name: Popular Cloud Computing Services
sub_topics.description: Coming back to cloud computing, some of the most popular cloud computing services in the market are AWS or Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Want to learn more about them and how they differ from each other?

key_points: IaaS provides access to basic computing infrastructure
PaaS provides cloud platforms and runtime environments for developing applications
Popular cloud computing services include AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
